changes.change: Handle a legitimate triggering state where the code broke; correct the producer of a state that should never exist instead of masking it. After a costly investigation, propose without implementing a cheap always-on signal.

Launch readiness proves a usable state from empty run-owned data through migrations and seed data. A proof in a stand-in environment lists the setup the target environment will not supply as unverified (shared by creation and maintenance).

Leftovers of an interrupted attempt must be recognizable as stale from evidence valid at every interruption point. Tests assert the classification, code or type callers branch on, and message text only where consumed.
